down.title: The app isn't responding
down.body: It isn't answering: its window may have been closed or it may have stopped. Open it again with its shortcut and reload this page.

broken.title: This page has failed
broken.body: It's a bug in the app, not a problem with your data: the other pages still work.
broken.report: If it keeps happening, tell us on <issues>GitHub</issues> what you were doing. The error details are in the browser console: press <kbd>F12</kbd> and open “Console”.

reminders.running: Your agent is working in the background

demo.label: Demo mode
demo.title: Demo mode: fictitious data.
demo.body: People, companies and jobs are made up; your real data is not touched.

running.title: Searching for jobs…
running.body: Your agent is still working in its window.

stale.title: No news from your agent
stale.body: It hasn't added anything for a while. Check its window: it may be waiting for you, or it may have closed.

no_browser.title: Your agent couldn't search
no_browser.body: It can't reach your browser. Connect it as “Before you start” explains and launch the search again.

stopped.title: Your agent stopped before the end
stopped.body: Its window says why. What it had already found is in the Inbox.

searchRun.problems_one: {{count}} problem on the job boards. See it in “Where to search”.
searchRun.problems_other: {{count}} problems on the job boards. See them in “Where to search”.

tasks.runningTerminal: Still going in your agent's window. If it asks for permission, answer there.
tasks.runningBackground: In the background: nothing for you to do.
tasks.stale: No news for 30 minutes. Check your agent's window or close this notice.

stopped.title: Your agent has stopped
stopped.body: It hasn't finished everything. Check its window to see why.

needs_user.title: Your agent needs to know something
needs_user.body: It stopped with a question for you.

process-jobs.running: Reading and assessing the new jobs…
